sections.title: Portland's technology identity and AI trajectory
sections.description: Portland's technology market has a distinctive character shaped by its outdoor, values-driven consumer culture.

blocks.heading: Nike's AI at the frontier of sports performance
paragraphs: Nike's AI investment is extraordinary in scope — the company has built one of the largest sports data science organizations in the world, acquiring a series of data companies (Zodiac for CLV prediction, Celect for inventory analytics, Datalogue for data integration, Invertex for foot scanning) to build an AI platform that touches product design, demand forecasting, and personalization. The Nike data science ecosystem in Beaverton has elevated Portland's entire technology sector.

blocks.heading: Oregon's clean energy technology leadership
paragraphs: Oregon's Renewable Portfolio Standard (100% clean electricity by 2040) has created one of the US's most ambitious clean energy markets. The Portland metro's clean energy technology sector — solar, wind, grid management, and energy storage — creates AI demand for generation forecasting, grid integration, and carbon measurement analytics that Oregon's ambitious clean energy targets require.

blocks.heading: Portland's B Corp and values-aligned technology community
paragraphs: Portland has one of the US's highest concentrations of B Corporations and values-aligned businesses. This creates a distinctive AI market demand — AI that measures sustainability impact, optimizes for social outcomes alongside financial returns, and is designed with explicit values alignment. Columbia Sportswear's RFID and supply chain traceability programs and Patagonia's environmental impact measurement both represent this values-aligned AI demand.
